title: Dentsu CTV Marketplace Powered by Magnite: Powering Smarter CTV for Cadillac
summary: Cadillac, a leading global luxury automotive brand, partnered with dentsu and Magnite to launch its latest vehicle lineup.
body_markdown:
Cadillac, a leading global luxury automotive brand, partnered with dentsu to launch its latest vehicle lineup across six Middle East markets: UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain.


The campaign aimed to build awareness and consideration among affluent, technology-forward consumers by combining the storytelling power of 30-second TV creative with the precision and premium environments of CTV.


View the case study to learn how Cadillac, Dentsu MENA and Magnite combined premium supply, audience intelligence and cross-publisher optimisation in a single activation strategy to achieve their campaign goals.
